title: Deliver Oil to Chenfingford Oil Refinery
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Oil** delivered to **Chenfingford Oil Refinery** (industry id 11, near tile 30,22).

A likely supplier is **Chenfingford Oil Wells** (industry id 8, near tile 36,14); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **290 units** within the horizon.

**Promise:** within the first 30 game-days, commit to a delivery quantity with `rh promise quantity=N` (the last promise before the deadline counts; max 680). You are paid for min(delivered, promised) and fined for any shortfall, so promise what you can really deliver: over- and under-promising both cost you.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
